what: An accent-color elliptical glow blooms at the bottom of a dark background, shimmering with noise (drifting about 40·30px), and a faint light follows the pointer at .08 per frame. As reveal (0→1) grows, the ellipse widens and its blurred edge softens. At full exit (0→1) the glow swells in place and covers the screen to the edges in the accent color — the consumer binds the element’s --fx-reveal · --fx-exit · --fx-alpha to scroll (WebGL shader)

options.reveal: Fill-up default (0~1), default 0.45 — inline --fx-reveal takes precedence if present
options.alpha: Share of the dark background that is painted (0~1), default 1 — at 0 only the light remains and the back shows through (inline --fx-alpha)
options.from: With top, the light shines from above, default is below
options.trail: Interaction spot light strength, default 0.18 — 0 turns it off (always off on touch devices)

use: <section data-fx="glow-field" data-fx-glow-field="from: top" style="height:100vh">…</section> · Tie to scroll: gsap.to(el, { '--fx-reveal': 1, scrollTrigger: { scrub: true } })

from.where: index.html hero stage, footer and works/about heads (original gradient-flow background: a green ellipse over a #0b0c10 base, flowing via fbm, with an interaction trail, reveal t·(.55+.45t)·.65, and on exit it swells in place until it fills the screen).

note: The original pushes light away with a separately drawn flow texture (trail) of pointer marks, but the part attaches one soft light to the pointer position. Not drawn when offscreen
